٧٢٩٧ — عن ابن عباس قال: وجد النبي ﷺ شاةً ميتةً أُعطيتْها مولاةٌ لميمونة من الصدقة، قال النبي ﷺ:
 (( هلاَّ انتفعتم بجلدها؟ ))
 قالوا: إنها ميتة. قال:
 (( إنما حرم أكلها )).
متفق عليه: رواه البخاري (١٤٩٢)، ومسلم (١٠١:٣٦٣).

7297 — Ibn ‘Abbas said: The Prophet ﷺ found a dead sheep that had been given in charity to a freedwoman of Maymunah. The Prophet ﷺ said:
“Why did you not benefit from its skin?”
They said: “It is dead.” He said:
“Only eating it has been forbidden.”
Agreed upon: Narrated by al-Bukhari (1492) and Muslim (363:101).

٧٢٩٩ — عن سودة زوج النبي ﷺ قالت: ماتتْ لنا شاةٌ، فدبغْنا مَسْكها، ثم ما زلنا نَنْبِذُ فيه حتى صار شَنّاً.
صحيح: رواه البخاري (٦٦٨٦). قولها: (( مَسْكها )) أي جلدها. وقولها: (( صار شَنّاً )) أي بالياً.

7299 — Sawdah, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ, said: A sheep of ours died, so we tanned its skin, and we continued to soak drinks in it until it became worn out.
Sahih: Narrated by al-Bukhari (6686).
Her statement, “its skin,” means its hide. Her statement, “until it became worn out,” means until it became old and worn.

٧٣٠٠ — عن ميمونة أن داجنةً كانت لبعض نساء رسول اللّٰه ﷺ فماتت، فقال رسول اللّٰه ﷺ:
 (( ألا أخذتم إهابها فاستمتعتم به؟ )).
صحيح: رواه مسلم (٣٦٤). و(( الداجنة )): هي الشاة التي تربى في البيت.

7300 — Maymunah narrated that a domestic sheep belonging to one of the wives of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ died. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
“Why did you not take its hide and benefit from it?”
Sahih: Narrated by Muslim (364).
The “domestic animal” here means a sheep raised in the house.

٧٣٠٢ — عن أبي الخير قال: رأيتُ على ابنِ وعلةَ السبئي فَرْواً، فمَسِسْتُه فقال: مالك تَمَسُّه؟ قد سألتُ عبد الله بن عباس، قلت: إنا نكونُ بالمغرب ومعنا البربرُ والمجوسُ، نُؤتى بالكبش قد ذبحوه، ونحن لا نأكل ذبائحهم، ويأتونا بالسقاء يجعلون فيه الودك، فقال ابن عباس: قد سألنا رسول اللّٰه ﷺ عن ذلك؟ فقال:
 (( دباغُه طهورُه )).
صحيح: رواه مسلم (١٠٦:٣٦٦).

english_source:
7302 — Abu al-Khayr said: I saw Ibn Wa‘lah al-Saba’i wearing a fur garment, so I touched it. He said: “Why are you touching it? I asked ‘Abdullah ibn ‘Abbas. I said: ‘We are in the Maghrib, and with us are Berbers and Magians. A ram they have slaughtered is brought to us, but we do not eat their slaughtered animals. They also bring us waterskins in which they put fat.’ Ibn ‘Abbas said: We asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about that, and he said:
‘Its tanning is its purification.’”
Sahih: Narrated by Muslim (366:106).

7303 — ‘A’ishah said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
“The tanning of a dead animal’s hide is its purification.”
Sahih: Narrated by al-Nasa’i in al-Sughra (4258), in al-Kubra (4559), and al-Tahawi in Sharh al-Ma‘ani (1/470).
In one of al-Tahawi’s wordings:
“The tanning of a dead animal’s skin is its purification.”

7306 — Salamah ibn al-Muhabbiq narrated that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed by a house with a water-skin hanging in its courtyard. He asked for water, and it was said: “It is from a dead animal.” He said:
“The purification of the hide is its tanning.”
Hasan: Narrated by Abu Dawud (4125) and al-Nasa’i (4243), and authenticated by Ibn Hibban (4522) and al-Hakim (4/141).

صحيح: رواه أبو داود (٤١٣٢)، والترمذي (١٧٧٠)، والنسائي (٤٢٦٤)، وأحمد (٢٠٧٠٦)، والحاكم (١/١٤٤)، والضياء في المختارة (١٣٩٥).

7307 — Abu al-Malih ibn Usamah narrated from his father that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the skins of predatory beasts. Another narration adds: that they be used as furnishings.
Sahih: Narrated by Abu Dawud (4132), al-Tirmidhi (1770), al-Nasa’i (4264), Ahmad (20706), al-Hakim (1/144), and al-Diya’ in al-Mukhtarah (1395).

٧٣٠٨ — عن معاوية بن أبي سفيان قال: قال رسول اللّٰه ﷺ:
 (( لا تركبوا الخزَّ ولا النمارَ )).
قال: وكان معاوية لا يُتهم في الحديث عن رسول اللّٰه ﷺ.
صحيح: رواه أبو داود (٤١٢٩)، وابن ماجه (٣٦٥٦)، وأحمد (١٦٨٤٠).

7308 — Mu‘awiyah ibn Abi Sufyan said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
“Do not ride on silk brocade or leopard skins.”
He said: Mu‘awiyah was not accused regarding his narration from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
Sahih: Narrated by Abu Dawud (4129), Ibn Majah (3656), and Ahmad (16840).

٧٣٠٩ — عن أبي شيخ الهنائي قال: كنتُ في ملأ من أصحاب رسول اللّٰه ﷺ عند معاوية، فقال معاوية: أنشدكم الله، أتعلمون أن رسول اللّٰه ﷺ نهى عن لبس الحرير؟ قالوا: اللهم نعم. قال: وأنا أشهد. قال: أنشدكم الله، أتعلمون أن رسول اللّٰه ﷺ نهى عن لبس الذهب إلا مقطعاً؟ قالوا: اللهم نعم. قال: وأنا أشهد. قال: أنشدكم الله، أتعلمون أن رسول اللّٰه ﷺ نهى عن ركوب النمور؟ قالوا: اللهم نعم. قال: وأنا أشهد. قال: أنشدكم الله، أتعلمون أن رسول اللّٰه ﷺ نهى عن الشرب في آنية الفضة؟ قالوا: اللهم نعم. قال: وأنا أشهد. قال: أنشدكم الله، أتعلمون أن رسول اللّٰه ﷺ نهى عن جمع بين حج وعمرة؟ قالوا: أما هذا، فلا. قال: أما إنها معهن.
حسن: رواه أبو داود (١٧٩٤)، والنسائي (٥١٦٦)، وأحمد (١٦٨٣٣). والسياق لأحمد.

english_source:
7309 — Abu Shaykh al-Huna’i said: I was among a group of the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with Mu‘awiyah. Mu‘awiyah said: “I ask you by Allah, do you know that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade wearing silk?” They said: “O Allah, yes.” He said: “And I bear witness.” He said: “I ask you by Allah, do you know that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade wearing gold except in small pieces?” They said: “O Allah, yes.” He said: “And I bear witness.” He said: “I ask you by Allah, do you know that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade riding on leopard skins?” They said: “O Allah, yes.” He said: “And I bear witness.” He said: “I ask you by Allah, do you know that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade drinking from vessels of silver?” They said: “O Allah, yes.” He said: “And I bear witness.” He said: “I ask you by Allah, do you know that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade combining Hajj and ‘Umrah?” They said: “As for this one, no.” He said: “Indeed, it is with them.”
Hasan: Narrated by Abu Dawud (1794), al-Nasa’i (5166), and Ahmad (16833). The wording is from Ahmad.

حسن: رواه أبو داود (١٧٩٤)، والنسائي (٥١٦٦)، وأحمد (١٦٨٣٣). والسياق لأحمد.
7309 — Abu Shaykh al-Huna’i said: I was among a group of the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with Mu‘awiyah. Mu‘awiyah said: “I ask you by Allah, do you know that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade wearing silk?” They said: “O Allah, yes.” He said: “And I bear witness.” He said: “I ask you by Allah, do you know that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade wearing gold except in small pieces?” They said: “O Allah, yes.” He said: “And I bear witness.” He said: “I ask you by Allah, do you know that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade riding on leopard skins?” They said: “O Allah, yes.” He said: “And I bear witness.” He said: “I ask you by Allah, do you know that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade drinking from vessels of silver?” They said: “O Allah, yes.” He said: “And I bear witness.” He said: “I ask you by Allah, do you know that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade combining Hajj and ‘Umrah?” They said: “As for this one, no.” He said: “Indeed, it is with them.”
Hasan: Narrated by Abu Dawud (1794), al-Nasa’i (5166), and Ahmad (16833). The wording is from Ahmad.

٧٣١١ — عن المقدام بن معديكرب أنه قال لمعاوية: أنشدك بالله، هل تعلمُ أن رسول اللّٰه ﷺ نهى عن لبس جلود السباع والركوب عليها؟ قال: نعم.
حسن: رواه أبو داود (٤١٣١)، والنسائي (٤٢٦٦)، ورواه الطبراني في الكبير (٢٠/٢٦٩، رقم ٦٣٦) مطولاً.

7311 — Al-Miqdam ibn Ma‘dikarib said to Mu‘awiyah: “I ask you by Allah, do you know that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade wearing the skins of predatory beasts and riding on them?” He said: “Yes.”
Hasan: Narrated by Abu Dawud (4131) and al-Nasa’i (4266). Al-Tabarani also narrated it at length in al-Kabir (20/269, no. 636).

٧٣١٢ — عن جابر قال: كنا نغزو مع رسول اللّٰه ﷺ، فنصيبُ من آنية المشركين وأسقيتهم فنستمتع بها، فلا يعيب ذلك عليهم.
حسن: رواه أبو داود (٣٨٣٨)، والبيهقي (١/٣٢)، وأحمد (١٥٠٥٣).

english_source:
7312 — Jabir said: We used to go on military expeditions with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and would acquire the vessels and water-skins of the polytheists, and we would benefit from them. He did not criticize them for that.
Hasan: Narrated by Abu Dawud (3838), al-Bayhaqi (1/32), and Ahmad (15053).
